page.overview:
What is Phyrexians?

Phyrexians are oil-twisted beings and machines who serve Phyrexia's gospel of perfection, invading planes from Mirrodin/New Phyrexia outward across the multiverse.

Also known as: Phyrexian, Phyrexian army.
